name: Hybrid rain: NASA daily timing scaled to the CHIRPS monthly total (js/rain.js)
note: Jan: NASA 10+30 = 40 mm, CHIRPS box 60 mm -> factor 1.5 (15, 45). Feb: NASA 0.4 mm (<1), CHIRPS 0 -> kept, 'chirps'. Mar: CHIRPS not published -> raw NASA, 'provisional'. Site in box (0,0) of a 2x2 grid of 0.1 deg; box value 600 = 60.0 mm.
